changes: Dialogs keep their heading and close control visible while the body scrolls; background page scrolling is locked.
Repayment, receipt review, confirmation and QR sharing keep the relevant amount and participants above the scrolling content.
Receipt review and settlement confirmation actions use the fixed dialog footer and retain the existing submit handlers and guards.
Compact image previews, single-line uploaded filenames, grouped share controls and expandable guidance reduce scrolling. Downloaded QR images retain their full resolution.
scope: Presentation changes only. The existing backend, balance calculations, pending transfer rules, authorization and idempotency remain unchanged. Browser flows used isolated local emulator accounts; no live financial records were modified.
